name: Elementary Geometry Exercises (K-5)
description: Foundational geometry concepts for young learners

exercises.title: Shape Recognition - Basic 2D Shapes
exercises.problem: Circle the triangles in this group of shapes: □ △ ○ ◇ △ ⬟

exercises.title: Count Sides and Corners
exercises.problem: How many sides and corners does a rectangle have?

exercises.title: Shape Sorting
exercises.problem: Sort these shapes into two groups - shapes with curves and shapes without curves: ○ □ △ ◯ ◇
hints: Straight shapes have only straight edges

exercises.title: Real World Shapes
exercises.problem: What shape is a window? What shape is a ball?
exercises.solution: Window: rectangle (or square), Ball: sphere (circle when viewed flat)
hints: Think about the outline of a window
What does a ball look like from any direction?

exercises.title: Pentagon Properties
exercises.problem: A pentagon has how many sides and how many angles?

exercises.title: Polygon Classification
exercises.problem: Name these polygons by their number of sides: 3 sides, 4 sides, 5 sides, 6 sides, 8 sides

exercises.title: Regular vs Irregular Polygons
exercises.problem: Which polygon is regular: a square or a rectangle that is not a square?
exercises.solution: A square is regular because all sides and angles are equal
hints: Regular means all sides equal AND all angles equal
Check if all sides are the same length

exercises.title: Right Angle Recognition
exercises.problem: Which angle is a right angle: 45°, 90°, or 120°?
hints: Right angles form a square corner
Think of the corner of a book

exercises.title: Acute and Obtuse Angles
exercises.problem: Classify these angles: 30°, 150°, 85°

exercises.title: Angles in Real Life
exercises.problem: What type of angle is formed when you open a door halfway? Fully open?
exercises.solution: Halfway: acute angle, Fully open: obtuse angle
hints: Think about how wide the opening is

exercises.title: Perimeter of Rectangle
exercises.problem: Find the perimeter of a rectangle with length 6 cm and width 4 cm.

exercises.title: Area of Rectangle
exercises.problem: Find the area of a rectangle with length 5 units and width 3 units.

exercises.title: Square Perimeter and Area
exercises.problem: A square has sides of 4 inches. Find its perimeter and area.
hints: All sides of a square are equal

exercises.title: Line Symmetry
exercises.problem: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
hints: Draw lines that divide the square into identical halves
Try vertical, horizontal, and diagonal lines

exercises.title: Symmetrical Shapes
exercises.problem: Which letter has line symmetry: F, H, or Z?
exercises.solution: H has line symmetry (vertical line through the middle)
hints: Imagine folding the letter in half

exercises.title: 3D Shape Recognition
exercises.problem: Name these 3D shapes: a box, a ball, a can, an ice cream cone
exercises.solution: Box: rectangular prism, Ball: sphere, Can: cylinder, Ice cream cone: cone
hints: How many faces does each have?

exercises.title: Faces, Edges, and Vertices
exercises.problem: How many faces, edges, and vertices does a cube have?
hints: Count each line where faces meet (edge)

exercises.title: Coordinate Points
exercises.problem: What are the coordinates of a point that is 3 units right and 2 units up from the origin?

exercises.title: Plotting Points
exercises.problem: Plot the points (1,3), (4,3), (4,1), and (1,1). What shape do they form?

exercises.title: Unit Conversion
exercises.problem: How many inches are in 2 feet?
